shortDescription: DWS XETR:DWS, the asset manager mostly owned by Germany's Deutsche Bank XETR:DBK, said on Tuesday that it would rename itself Deutsche Asset Management later this year to underscore its German and European origins.

children: , the asset manager mostly owned by Germany's Deutsche Bank
, said on Tuesday that it would rename itself Deutsche Asset Management later this year to underscore its German and European origins.
DWS said the move would help create a clear global identity under European leadership.
"Our ambitions are international – and that calls for a new approach," DWS CEO Stefan Hoops said.
The renaming is effective from early November.
Individual existing product brand names - like DWS for European private wealth clients and Xtrackers for ETFs - will remain unchanged.
